other_failure_modes.name: Arbitrary Data Truncation
other_failure_modes.description: The training data is arbitrarily truncated to a fixed number of rows from the beginning of the dataset. For data ordered by time or subject, this discards massive amounts of information and severely biases the training set toward specific time periods or subjects.

summary: The solution appropriately formulates the regression task and applies solid feature engineering techniques, including cyclical temporal encodings. However, it critically fails by ignoring temporal order during validation splitting (introducing look-ahead bias) and by arbitrarily truncating the massive training dataset to the first 1,000,000 rows, which likely discards the vast majority of the temporal and building-specific variations present in the full dataset.
